headline: GTA 6 Finally Launches; Nation's 2013 New Year's Resolutions Called to Collect
subheadline: *After 13 years in development, the game arrives to find its original fans now have mortgages, children, and a much lower tolerance for queuing.*
author: Rowan Delacroix, Interactive Regrets Desk
seoTitle: GTA 6 Launches After 13 Years; 2013 Resolutions Come Due
seoDescription: Satire: GTA 6 finally launches worldwide after 13 years in development, forcing everyone who resolved to play it in 2013 to face the consequences.
sourceEvent: Grand Theft Auto 6 has launched worldwide after 13 years in development, with fans in the UK joining a global frenzy of queues, pre-orders and midnight store openings. The game is expected to become one of the most popular entertainment products ever released.

social.x: GTA 6 is out after 13 years in development, making it the first New Year's resolution from 2013 to legally come due. Fans who vowed to play it 'day one' are being located and made to pay up.
social.facebook: Grand Theft Auto 6 has gone on sale worldwide after 13 years in development, ending what historians call the longest a video game has kept anyone waiting without a formal apology. In the UK, fans queued from midnight — many reuniting with queue-mates from the GTA V launch in 2013, now returning with bad knees, shared custody arrangements, and pre-ordered snacks. Anyone who made a New Year's resolution in 2013 to play it 'the day it comes out' has been formally notified that the debt is due.
social.linkedin: The worldwide launch of GTA 6, after a 13-year development cycle, offers a useful case study in long-horizon product management: anticipation, properly maintained, appears to appreciate rather than decay. Analysts note the title entered production when 'disruption' still meant something. Full thoughts below.
social.instagram: GTA 6 is finally out after 13 years in development. If you made a 2013 New Year's resolution to play it on day one, congratulations, and also we're so sorry. #satire #gta6 #grandtheftauto #gaming #finally
altHeadlines: GTA 6 Out Now; Fans Who Vowed Patience in 2013 Collect Their Winnings From God
GTA 6 Launches; Britain's 28-Year-Olds Call In Sick With Mysterious 'Leonida Flu'

body:
LONDON — Grand Theft Auto 6 went on sale worldwide this morning, ending a 13-year development cycle and triggering what historians are calling the largest reconciliation with abandoned New Year's resolutions in recorded history.

The game, which entered production when David Cameron was Prime Minister and has survived three console generations, five prime ministers, and one entire cultural lifespan of the word 'vibes,' immediately became the fastest-selling entertainment product since the last thing humanity collectively agreed to lose its mind about.

'We're thrilled to finally get the game into players' hands,' said a spokesperson for the publisher, reading from a statement originally drafted in 2014 and updated annually by a dedicated anticipation-maintenance team. 'We'd also like to thank fans for their patience, defined here as a willingness to rewatch the same trailer 400 times while visibly aging.'

In the UK, fans queued outside shops from midnight, many reuniting with queue-mates they first met at the GTA V launch in 2013 — now returning with bad knees, shared custody arrangements, and thermoses.

'I was 15 when I resolved to play this the day it came out,' said local man Daniel Prewitt, 28, waiting outside a shop in Croydon while his wife held a sleeping toddler. 'Now I'm keeping a promise I made to a child. He's mine. It's complicated.'

Set in the fictional state of Leonida — a legally distinct version of Florida — the game offers a satirical take on modern life, which critics note took 13 years to write largely because modern life kept overtaking the satire and the writers had to start again.

One analyst described the launch as a generational economic event, calculating that if everyone who claimed in 2013 they were 'definitely buying it day one' follows through, the GDP forecasts of several small nations will need revising upward.

Retailers reported brisk trade in launch-day bundles containing the game, an energy drink, and a leaflet gently reminding players to contact their families by Thursday.

Those unable to secure a copy have been advised to remain calm and begin saving for the sequel. 'Pre-orders for GTA 7 open next quarter,' the spokesperson confirmed. 'Current projections put release sometime in the Sun's red giant phase. Do keep your 2013 resolutions somewhere safe — they're now legally enforceable documents.'

At press time, a nation of 28-to-38-year-olds was calling in sick with a mysterious virus doctors have classified as 'Leonida flu.'
